title: ID0420418-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S7 170003961] OCPP backend
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
We will put the charger into operation remotely on April 29. OMV connects the OCPP backend via Ethernet. Since we cannot configure these settings in the SCB, we need a support with SSH access to configure the router for us. The comisioning is planed around 9a.m. (UTC+02:00) ChargerIP: 10.236.49.131 Gateway: 10.236.49.254 Netmask:255.255.255.0
